decisions.reason: The candidate already distinguishes wallet-free fiat minting from the wallet required to receive affiliate commissions; the added Transak payment methods do not change reward-access state.
Supported fiat payment methods and wallet prerequisites do not change the NFT ebook product type or unlimited supply model.
The Transak payment-method clarification does not alter the $15 mint price or no-hidden-fees condition.
Adding card, Apple Pay, and Google Pay as fiat methods does not change the established per-sale revenue allocations.

The commission Requirement already records that a recipient wallet is required for payment; wallet-free fiat minting does not change the commission trigger, recipient, amount, or delivery destination.
Fiat methods for primary minting do not change secondary-sale royalty amounts, allocations, pool funding, or ticket behavior.
The fiat payment options and wallet prerequisite clarification do not alter badge triggers, thresholds, or on-chain award destination.
The Transak fiat-mint options do not change Big Block ticket issuance, pool funding, draw parameters, or winner selection.
The Transak fiat-mint options do not change Small Block ticket issuance, pool funding, draw parameters, or ticket reset rules.
The FAQ Requirement already directs publication of the complete same-message FAQ, including its fiat methods and wallet-requirement text; no additional state change is necessary.
SIWE remains required only for the candidate's crypto-user flows; wallet-free Transak fiat minting is a separate non-crypto path and does not modify that authentication rule.
Fiat payment methods and mint-time wallet requirements do not alter the book, referral code, badges, or expired-ticket state transferred with an NFT.
